one_off_rewrite.notebook: databricks/notebooks/lineage_rewrite.py, serverless CPU, SQL only, no model
steps: record each table's current Delta version
gold_prediction_audit: INSERT OVERWRITE with its own rows inner-joined to silver_images on isic_id

gold_drift_monthly: ADD COLUMNS audit_rows BIGINT, baseline_rows BIGINT; INSERT OVERWRITE with its own rows left-joined to the per-month row count of gold_prediction_audit and the per-bundle row count of gold_drift_baseline
checks: audit and baseline: the rewritten table equals its pre-rewrite version exactly (EXCEPT ALL both ways is empty, row counts equal)

monthly: the five original columns equal the pre-rewrite version exactly; audit_rows equals the sum of by_source in the row's summary (0 where the month scored nothing); baseline_rows equals sizes.baseline_images in the summary
one_off_rewrite.on_any_failed_check: RESTORE each table to its recorded version, then fail the run

lineage_read: edges into the three tables from system.access.table_lineage, read after the run; the system table lags, so the read is repeated until the edges appear, and only edges seen in the table are reported
not_changed: no score, flag, alert or month is recomputed; results/phase3/monthly/ is not touched; the monthly spec (results/phase3/monthly/spec.json) is unchanged apart from the two count columns stated here
